# cztrading212

Python SDK for Trading 212's Public API v0. The core package provides raw,
validated services, and read-only application workflows. CLI and MCP adapters
are optional. The API is beta and this package is an early alpha.

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [OpenAPI generation and upstream review](docs/generation.md)
- [Operation mapping](docs/api-mapping.md)
- [Caching and privacy](docs/caching.md)
- [Rate limiting and retries](docs/reliability.md)
- [Application calculations](docs/application.md)
- [Order safety](docs/safety.md)
- [CLI](docs/cli.md)
- [Read-only MCP](docs/mcp.md)
- [Release and versioning](docs/release.md)
- Operation catalog: `src/cztrading212/_generated/operations.json`

Raw calls can submit real orders in the live environment and do not retry,
cache, deduplicate, or resolve unknown outcomes. MCP has no trading tools.
